hypothesis: Control success is structurally impossible whenever reverse or middle increments. A coherent factorization should first estimate the 12 observed reverse/middle/ball/strike patterns, then estimate success only inside the three r0m0 call patterns and marginalize those conditional experts.

relationship_to_prior_work.failure_decomposition: Prior independent reverse/middle/wayoff probabilities overlapped and were clipped after subtraction.
relationship_to_prior_work.failure_chain: Prior chain used the coarse reverse_any taxonomy and multiplied sequential binary survivals without modelling ball/strike patterns.
relationship_to_prior_work.component15: Prior component15 classifier fragmented each pattern into success/failure joint classes. This recipe shares a pattern gate and fits only three well-populated conditional success experts.

data_contract.component_pattern_labels: next same-pitcher official reverse/middle/ball/strike counter increments inside completed history only

candidate.prediction_formula: sum over eligible patterns of P(pattern|x) * P(success|pattern,x)
candidate.features: exact-C common features plus row-local e53 K20 pitchmix and completed-history e58 physics profiles
candidate.selection: maximize minimum full gain across 2020/2021, then minimum R gain, then smaller gamma

source_gate.on_pass: Freeze gamma and recipe before 2022/2023; open 2024 only after the locked development contract passes.
